title: dembrane v3: customers
description: Production customer activity: fresh signals, repeat use, adoption and momentum. Organisation-level counts only; no transcripts, emails or prompts.

list.name: audience
list.label: Audience
list.query: Hide dembrane : external, All organisations : all

list.name: customer
list.label: Organisation
list.query: SELECT org_name || ' · ' || left(org_id,8) AS __text, org_id AS __value FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR lower(btrim(org_name))<>'dembrane') ORDER BY org_name
list.definition: SELECT org_name || ' · ' || left(org_id,8) AS __text, org_id AS __value FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR lower(btrim(org_name))<>'dembrane') ORDER BY org_name

options.content: **Production only.** Fresh audio, onboarding and server-side actions, then customer usage over the selected time. Sample projects, copied conversations and deleted content are excluded. Organisation names do not prove paid status. A quiet radar does not mean nobody has a page open. No transcripts, email addresses or prompts are exposed. The default audience hides dembrane's own organisation; other trial/demo organisations can still appear.

panels.title: Customer radar: fixed live windows, independent of the time picker
Fresh audio conversations (3m)
panels.description: Conversations with audio arriving within three minutes, with client and server timestamp guards. Not an unfinished-conversation count. Uploads are not live recording.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(audio_conversations),0) AS value FROM obs.customer_live WHERE (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Onboarding sessions (90s)
panels.description: Unexpired visitor signals seen within 90 seconds. Sessions are not unique people.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(onboarding_sessions),0) AS value FROM obs.customer_live WHERE (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Organisations with fresh signals
panels.description: Fresh audio/onboarding, or a project, conversation, chat or report action in the last 15 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT org_id) AS value FROM obs.customer_live WHERE (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Database checked at
panels.description: Time this live read succeeded, not proof of customer activity. Errors remain visible.

panels.title: Who is doing what now
panels.description: Empty means no signal in these windows, not zero logged-in people. Audio and onboarding have shorter windows than chat/report activity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT org_id, org_name AS "Organisation",workspace_name AS "Workspace",project_name AS "Project",CASE WHEN audio_conversations>0 THEN 'Fresh audio' WHEN onboarding_sessions>0 THEN 'Onboarding' WHEN chats_15m>0 THEN 'Using chat' WHEN reports_15m>0 THEN 'Creating analysis' ELSE 'Project / conversation activity' END AS "Signal",audio_conversations AS "Audio (3m)",onboarding_sessions AS "Onboarding",chats_15m AS "Questions (15m)",reports_15m AS "Outputs (15m)",last_signal_at AS "Last signal" FROM obs.customer_live WHERE (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane'))) ORDER BY last_signal_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Customer use over the selected time: core actions, not pageviews
Active organisations
panels.description: Organisations with retained input, user chat questions or published/archived outputs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT org_id) FILTER (WHERE action IN ('conversation','chat','report')) AS value FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Active projects
panels.description: Non-sample projects with a core action.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT project_id) FILTER (WHERE action IN ('conversation','chat','report')) AS value FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Conversations added
panels.description: New non-cloned conversations, including uploads. Not a unique-participant count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='conversation') AS value FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Audio hours added
panels.description: Conversation durations attributed to their start time. Includes uploads; ongoing durations can grow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((coalesce(sum(audio_minutes),0)/60)::numeric,1) AS value FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Chat questions
panels.description: Human user messages only. Assistant responses are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='chat') AS value FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Analysis outputs
panels.description: Published or archived report/popcorn rows by creation time. Versions count separately; errors do not count as outputs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='report') AS value FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane')))

panels.title: Customer use patterns
panels.description: Descriptive use patterns, not a churn score. Counts are product actions, not individuals or paid accounts.

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS (SELECT org_id,count(DISTINCT project_id) AS projects,count(DISTINCT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date) FILTER (WHERE action IN ('conversation','chat','report')) AS active_days,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='conversation') AS conversations,round(coalesce(sum(audio_minutes),0)::numeric,1) AS audio_minutes,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='chat') AS questions,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='report') AS outputs,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='report_error') AS output_errors,max(occurred_at) AS last_at FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane'))) GROUP BY org_id) SELECT o.org_id,o.org_name AS "Organisation",u.projects AS "Projects",u.active_days AS "Active days",u.conversations AS "Conversations",u.audio_minutes AS "Audio minutes",u.questions AS "Questions",u.outputs AS "Outputs",u.output_errors AS "Output errors",CASE WHEN u.conversations>0 AND u.questions+u.outputs>0 THEN 'Capture + analysis' WHEN u.conversations>0 THEN 'Capture only' WHEN u.questions+u.outputs>0 THEN 'Analysis of existing input' ELSE 'Setup / error only' END AS "Use pattern",u.last_at AS "Last action" FROM u JOIN obs.customer_organisations o USING(org_id) ORDER BY u.active_days DESC,u.conversations+u.questions+u.outputs DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Customer pulse: first use and return visits
panels.description: One organisation per Amsterdam day. First use means first retained core action, not signup or first-ever use of deleted content. First/last days may be partial.

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series((($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date)::timestamp,(($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date)::timestamp,interval '1 day')::date AS day), active AS (SELECT org_id,(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date AS day FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND action IN ('conversation','chat','report') AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane'))) GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT greatest(days.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time,count(a.org_id) FILTER (WHERE (f.first_use_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date=days.day) AS "First retained use",count(a.org_id) FILTER (WHERE (f.first_use_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date<days.day) AS "Returning organisations" FROM days LEFT JOIN active a USING(day) LEFT JOIN obs.customer_first_use f USING(org_id) GROUP BY days.day ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Capture and analysis across customers
panels.description: Action counts are shown separately; no blended health score. Zero-filled calendar days, selected-time filtering.

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series((($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date)::timestamp,(($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date)::timestamp,interval '1 day')::date AS day), u AS (SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam')::date AS day,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='conversation') AS conversations,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='chat') AS questions,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='report') AS outputs FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane'))) GROUP BY 1) SELECT greatest(days.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS time,coalesce(u.conversations,0) AS "Conversations",coalesce(u.questions,0) AS "Questions",coalesce(u.outputs,0) AS "Analysis outputs" FROM days LEFT JOIN u USING(day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Signals worth a closer look: fixed seven-day windows
Picking up: more core actions
panels.description: Rolling seven days compared with the preceding seven days. Absolute change avoids percentage spikes from a tiny baseline.

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS (SELECT org_id,count(*) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '7d') AS current_actions,count(*) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at<now()-interval '7d') AS previous_actions,max(occurred_at) AS last_at FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '14d' AND action IN ('conversation','chat','report') AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane'))) GROUP BY org_id) SELECT o.org_id,o.org_name AS "Organisation",current_actions AS "This 7d",previous_actions AS "Previous 7d",current_actions-previous_actions AS "Change",last_at AS "Last action" FROM u JOIN obs.customer_organisations o USING(org_id) WHERE current_actions>previous_actions ORDER BY current_actions-previous_actions DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Quieter: fewer core actions
panels.description: Less observed use is not proof of churn. Seasonality, completed workshops and internal/test use can explain it.

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS (SELECT org_id,count(*) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '7d') AS current_actions,count(*) FILTER (WHERE occurred_at<now()-interval '7d') AS previous_actions,max(occurred_at) AS last_at FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '14d' AND action IN ('conversation','chat','report') AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane'))) GROUP BY org_id) SELECT o.org_id,o.org_name AS "Organisation",current_actions AS "This 7d",previous_actions AS "Previous 7d",current_actions-previous_actions AS "Change",last_at AS "Last action" FROM u JOIN obs.customer_organisations o USING(org_id) WHERE previous_actions>current_actions ORDER BY previous_actions-current_actions DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Capture-only organisations: an adoption opportunity
panels.description: At least three inputs in seven days, no user chat/report output in that window. A conversation starter, not an automatic outreach instruction.

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS (SELECT org_id,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='conversation') AS inputs,count(*) FILTER (WHERE action IN ('chat','report')) AS analyses,max(occurred_at) AS last_at FROM obs.customer_activity WHERE occurred_at>=now()-interval '7d' AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR org_id NOT IN (SELECT org_id FROM obs.customer_organisations WHERE lower(btrim(org_name))='dembrane'))) GROUP BY org_id) SELECT o.org_id,o.org_name AS "Organisation",inputs AS "Inputs (7d)",last_at AS "Last action" FROM u JOIN obs.customer_organisations o USING(org_id) WHERE inputs>=3 AND analyses=0 ORDER BY inputs DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent organisations: first-use milestones (30d)
panels.description: Real milestones, not signup conversion estimates. User chat is a request, not a guarantee of a successful answer. Includes trial/internal organisations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT o.org_id,o.org_name AS "Organisation",o.created_at AS "Organisation created",(SELECT count(*) FROM obs.customer_projects d WHERE d.org_id=o.org_id) AS "Own projects",f.first_input_at AS "First input",f.first_analysis_at AS "First chat / output",CASE WHEN f.first_analysis_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Analysis observed' WHEN f.first_input_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Input observed' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM obs.customer_projects d WHERE d.org_id=o.org_id) THEN 'Project created' ELSE 'No own project yet' END AS "Milestone" FROM obs.customer_organisations o LEFT JOIN obs.customer_first_use f USING(org_id) WHERE o.created_at>=now()-interval '30d' AND (('__all' IN (${customer:sqlstring}) OR o.org_id IN (${customer:sqlstring})) AND (${audience:sqlstring}='all' OR lower(btrim(o.org_name))<>'dembrane')) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Coverage and limits: missing data is not healthy data
Inputs without organisation attribution (200d)
panels.description: Eligible non-sample, non-cloned inputs with no valid organisation mapping. Not silently counted as a customer. Fixed 200-day window, all organisations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT unattributed_conversations_200d AS value FROM obs.customer_attribution_coverage

options.content:
- Fresh audio is a **3-minute signal**, not a promise that a participant is still recording.
- Pageviews, idle dashboard tabs and identifiable people are not measured here.
- Organisation activity is not proof of payment, retention or customer satisfaction.
- Samples, copied conversations and deleted content are excluded. Customer views cover up to **200 days** of retained source rows.
- SQL/API errors stay visible. Empty attribution and quiet windows are not treated as a broken product.
- Click an organisation name to focus the dashboard.
